label: Contained explanatory resources expose the base without erasing proximate reasons
meaning: The contained interpretation grants fixed truth-preserving rules, actual prerequisites, existing causal predecessors and reasons for every derivative. The existing trap obstruction excludes FullSupply from law and background alone. Induction constructs every derivative after admitting base and extracts base plus law from any derivation with no derivative primitive. Changing only the modal overlay separates resource deficiency from modal contingency. The result concerns the displayed rules and resource policies, whose adequacy and exhaustiveness are not assumed.
